name: zrndr_span_mmx_set_tex_uv_masks_and_vshift
description: zRndr::SpanMmxSetTexUvMasksAndVShift precomputes duplicated MMX texture U/V masks and the V shift count for MMX span routines.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 COFF byte compare passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 32 relocation bytes; 14 trailing VC object NOP padding bytes are trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49ea40 validates duplicated g_spanActiveTexVMask stores into the MMX V mask pair, zeroing the high V-shift count, storing texVShift into the low count, and duplicating g_spanActiveTexUMask shifted left by 20 into the MMX U mask pair.
The native smoke verifies the V-shift count, cleared high count, duplicated nonzero V mask, duplicated shifted U mask, and subsequent tex16 MMX span setup behavior.
